protocol_note.clean_small_step_rule: camera depth 0.50-0.70 m and |camera x,y| <= 0.12 m
protocol_note.interpretation: The trace contains larger hand motions than the planned 5-10 cm steps. Those rows are retained but are not used as the clean small-step baseline. No visual interval is discarded as a misidentification solely from depth.

fusion_diagnostic.interpretation: Forward model selection is informative during motion: model 2 is preferred in most dynamic samples. Right/down have many rejected windows because this run did not excite those axes cleanly; their weights are not used to justify a cost change.

tuning_decision.recommendation: Test only controller.position_weights[0] from 800 to 1000; keep horizon, fusion, force weights, delta-force weights, vision and firmware unchanged.
tuning_decision.reason: Clean small-step forward static P95 remains about 6.3 cm and dynamic forward P95 about 17.5 cm. Forward occasionally reaches the +/-0.20 channel and force boundary while applied motor throttle remains far below 0.50; dynamic fusion already selects model 2. A single forward position-weight increase is the direct next test for reducing lag without changing the model selector or motor limits.
tuning_decision.next_experiment: Repeat only 5-10 cm forward/back steps, 10 s per position, three cycles, depth 0.55-0.75 m. Compare forward P95, first overshoot, return time, and whether channel saturation increases.
